verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at inference-docs.cerebras.ai that indexes the docs, and doc pages are served as Markdown (.md) with a header telling agents to fetch the complete documentation index from llms.txt. The llms.txt also lists downloadable OpenAPI specs, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/llms.txt # Cerebras Inference
